title: common.json
description: Common elements used all over, put stuff here before it gets it's own file

tickets.description: How many tickets do I have

review.description: What review did I give the movie

imdb_id.description: The imdb id of the movie

wikidata_id.description: The Wikidata item of the work (Q followed by digits); its IMDb id (P345) must match the entry's imdb_id. Every work has one: create the item on Wikidata when it is missing

rotten_tomatoes_id.description: The Rotten Tomatoes path of the work (m/<slug> for a film, tv/<slug> for a series), as recorded on its Wikidata item (P1258) or verified by hand; null when Rotten Tomatoes has no page for the work
